text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool in this session, so the fixes come from reading the code against the tests.

- **`fees.py`:** the fee used `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It now uses `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of the `[-n - 1:]` slice. It now returns exactly `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing Emma. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies for Emma are my guess, since the tests only check the title and the count.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it with `int()`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
